groups.sentence: Instructors tell students how AI use must be cited or acknowledged in their course.
Students cite or properly attribute any AI-generated content or AI use in their work.
Students include the prompts they used when citing, acknowledging or disclosing AI use.
Students disclose their AI use, identifying the specific tool or tools used and its provider.
Students describe how and where they used the AI tool in their work.
Sample disclosure and acknowledgment statements show how students can describe their AI use.
Students cite AI using an accepted citation style such as APA, MLA or Chicago, as their discipline or class requires.
Students add a note, paragraph or appendix at the end of the assignment disclosing their AI use.
Example reference formats show how to cite AI tools in APA, MLA or similar styles.
Students give the AI tool's name, version and date or URL of access in their citation or disclosure.
Students check with their instructor or consult guidance about how to cite or disclose AI use.
Students may be required to submit their prompts as part of their work or documentation.
Everyone documents AI use in detail, including model versions, prompts and limitations, for transparency and reproducibility.
Students follow their instructor's requirements for AI citation and disclosure.
Instructors may require AI-use documents or disclosures describing tools, prompts and how AI was used.
Students include the raw AI output, not only their final product, in their submission.
Students describe how they verified or reviewed AI-generated content.
Students cite the specific AI writing tool when they present more than one sentence of minimally edited AI text.
Everyone takes care to avoid plagiarism when using AI and does not use AI to plagiarize without citation.
Students who cannot save or share an AI chat cite it as personal communication, in the text only.
Writers may cite the original source directly instead of the AI tool once they have confirmed it.
AI citation resources exist, and citing AI differs from citing traditional sources.
